_note: Hand-written W2-S7 first-user-message fixtures (author's own paraphrases of the tau2 reason_for_call texts).

cases.text: Hi, my phone has been showing 'No Service' for the past few hours.
I have no signal at all and I can't make calls.
My phone says no bars and emergency calls only.
My mobile data is really slow, it either stops working or crawls.
The internet on my phone is not working and web pages take forever to load.
I have terrible data speeds and I want excellent speed back.
I'm unable to send MMS messages with my messaging app.
I can't send pictures to my friends in a text.
I have no service and also my internet is slow when it does work.
Hello, I need help with my phone.
